betterquesting:10.desc:8:
The §6Precision Laser Etcher§f etches Gold, Redstone, and a Silicon Wafer into a §6Basic Circuit Plate§f. This is the board that backs every Basic Circuit and Tracking Circuit in the mod.

The plate is consumed at a 1:4 ratio by the Cutting Machine to produce Basic Circuits, and you'll need a lot of them. Every machine, every rocket component, every multiblock uses control circuits, and they all start here.

There's also a Precision Laser Etcher recipe that produces 2x plates per craft using four wafers and a lens module. If you can supply the materials, it's the more efficient path.

§ePS:§f Bulk-produce 32+ plates at a time. You'll burn through them faster than you think, especially once you start building multiblocks.
